evidence: We partner with external vendors to offer leadership and professional development opportunities such as coaching for improved performance, time management, project management, Generative AI in the workplace, data analytics, critical thinking and problem solving.
We are increasingly incorporating artificial intelligence and machine-learning technologies into our operations, products, and services.

These technologies present risks, including inaccurate or unreliable outputs, data quality limitations, regulatory uncertainty, intellectual property concerns, cybersecurity vulnerabilities, data privacy concerns, performance issues and reputational harm.
If we are unable to responsibly develop, deploy, and manage artificial intelligence technologies, our business and financial results could be adversely affected.
As we continue to design and develop smart and connected products, service [offerings may be vulnerable to attacks and cybersecurity incidents].
